name: talkback
description: Hands-free Claude Code: Claude speaks its replies and, in live mode, listens for yours. All speech runs on this machine, on macOS, Linux and Windows

voice.title: Neural voice
voice.description: The Kokoro voice /talkback init speaks with (af_heart, am_michael, bf_emma, hf_alpha for Hindi, ...).

lang.title: Neural language
lang.description: The language the neural voice reads in (en-us, en-gb, hi, es, fr-fr, it, ja, pt-br, cmn).

length.title: Spoken length
length.description: brief: Claude opens each reply with a short spoken summary and only that is read. normal: the first part of the reply. full: all of it.

headphones.title: Headphones
headphones.description: On: the microphone stays open while Claude speaks, so talking over the voice interrupts it. Leave off with speakers, or Claude hears itself.
